hint: tap anywhere to light the mountain sky

game.q: why “read in the name of your Lord,” and not just “read”? your guess?
opts: to give the book its title
so he would not be starting alone
to make it sound more formal

wrong.title: good thought, but the book is named for “read.”
wrong.formal: not about sounding formal. it’s about company.

game.right: YES. starting in God’s name means the work isn’t done alone. the beginning is carried.

end.line: he said he couldn’t read. the first words told him to read in God’s name, and he began.
end.l2: he began anyway, in God’s name.

cliff.s2: said many times a day, and a promise kept at a mosque door.

share: a cave, a mountain, and the first word: read. the story on infinite hill
